text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This day has finally come,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's your debut race, Trainer, isn't it?
My heart is just so full right now~

If anything, it felt more like
Super Creek's debut race...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Did you bring a handkerchief? Tissues?
Don't go forgetting anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I made suuure to iron my clothes yesterday~
Now, time to head outside...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa, such incredible cheering...
To think it echoes all the way out here. So this is... the racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you alright?
Please don't be afraid.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to fear, nothing to fear... right?
If you just stay calm, I'm sure your true strength will...
choice_data_list: Creek's the one doing the running, though.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Uh, ah, yes... You're right.
The one running amidst all these cheers is me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What should I do~?
My heart suddenly started racing.
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to your run!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... Trainer, when you look at me
with those sparkling eyes, I just...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best somehow... don't I?
So that I don't show an unsightly display.
